description:
This all-new concept car illustrates what the first all-electric BMW M3 could look like. We will run you through the design, likely performance figures, and everything else you need to know. 

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-12-06

Introducing the all-new BMW M3!

…Well, not exactly. This is the M Concept Neue Klasse - a concept car that is designed to illustrate what the first M-powered version of the BMW i3 could look like! 

(Fear not though, petrol-heads - there’s still a new petrol-powered M3 on the horizon!)

First up, let’s check out the design - and there’s no denying BMW has tried to give this car as much presence as possible! Up front there’s a massive flat grille with the headlights inside, colourful DRLs (usually reserved for CS models), and massive louvres in the bonnet! Along the side, the door mirrors have been updated and M-coloured graphics added to the carbon fibre roof, while around the back there are TWO ducktail spoilers
title: New BMW M3 just DESTROYED AMG!
